comment: Every path under a mapped module directory that differs from, or is absent at, the StuRa tag extraction-source-f2 (services/** and the content UI half). scripts/check-module-source-parity.mjs refuses any unlisted difference, any listed path that does not differ (stale), any set-A path, and any entry whose pinned kernel blob no longer matches (a further edit updates its entry).

entries.reason: upstream stale manifest: at the tag, manifest.json records sha256 5c406c47… for 001_init.sql while the tag's 001_init.sql hashes to fae5fb11… (unchanged since at least e1814598). The package's prebuild (scripts/build-migration-manifest.mjs) rewrites it on every build — the leaf image already ships the regenerated value — so the committed file now equals the generator's output and a build leaves the tree clean
